name: claude-topics
description: The claude-topics marketplace — procedures for picking up, putting down, forking and handing off long-running Claude Code work, across machines and Claude Code profiles.

plugins.name: topics
plugins.description: Pick up, put down, fork, rename and hand off long-running Claude Code topics — a topic being a stable name that outlives the session beneath it, so work survives being resumed, set aside, split in two, moved between profiles, or handed to a fresh session. Teaches Claude the procedures; the `topic` CLI does the work.
